_doc: A NEMA 14 stepper, 34 mm body (14HS13-0804S). kind as in x1c.json. Mounting face at z = 0, shaft up +z from the origin.
name: nema14

type.rule: What sort of motor it is

body_shape.rule: A square frame with its corners cut

body_corner.rule: How far each corner is cut back, along each side

boss_diameter.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

boss_height.rule: Pilot boss height above the mounting face
boss_height.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

shaft_diameter.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

shaft_length.rule: Shaft length from the mounting face

shaft_flat_across.rule: Across the shaft and its D flat
shaft_flat_across.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

shaft_flats.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

mount_pattern.rule: Four holes on a square, centred on the shaft
mount_pattern.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it

mount_hole_spacing.source: NEMA ICS 16, frame size 14: the 1.4 in frame, 26 mm hole square, as every maker of it draws it
